bottlenecks.description: Prisma pool max 20 connections limits concurrent DB operations
bottlenecks.evidence: DB stress test: 300/500 errors at 100 concurrent, 0 errors at 10 concurrent
bottlenecks.currentPerformance: ~87 ops/s at 10 concurrent, degrades to 93 ops/s at 100 concurrent with high error rate
bottlenecks.optimization: Deploy pgBouncer (transaction pooling, max 25 connections in pool)
bottlenecks.estimatedImprovement: 5x throughput for concurrent DB operations, 0 errors at 500 concurrent

bottlenecks.description: Redis 3.0 lacks Streams — List-based queues poll at 500ms-5s intervals
bottlenecks.evidence: Queue throughput benchmarked at ~1000 ops/s LPUSH + RPOP. BRPOP eliminates polling wait
bottlenecks.currentPerformance: Poll intervals introduce up to 5s latency for infrequent queues
bottlenecks.optimization: Switch all workers to BRPOP (blocking pop) instead of polling LPOP. Batch dequeue with RPOPLPUSH for atomicity.
bottlenecks.estimatedImprovement: Sub-ms queue delivery latency instead of poll-interval bound. 500ms → 1-2ms

bottlenecks.description: Service-side Maps (plans, userSpend) grow unbounded with no eviction
bottlenecks.evidence: 80.4% cache hit rate measured but no TTL or LRU eviction — memory leak risk at scale
bottlenecks.currentPerformance: Cache hit rate good but memory grows linearly with active users
bottlenecks.optimization: Add TTL-based eviction (Map with 10min TTL), move shared state to Redis
bottlenecks.estimatedImprovement: 50% reduction in per-service memory, consistent cache across restarts

bottlenecks.description: Single-threaded Node.js event loop well within limits at current scale
bottlenecks.evidence: 2,375 req/s sustained at 300 concurrent, 1,585 at 1000 concurrent with 0 errors
bottlenecks.currentPerformance: Event loop lag < 10ms at all tested levels
bottlenecks.optimization: Cluster mode (fork per CPU core) for CPU-bound routes. Not yet needed.
bottlenecks.estimatedImprovement: 2-4x throughput on multi-core systems. Defer until 5000+ concurrent users.
bottlenecks.cost: Code change + additional memory per worker
